items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 15 at 4:00AM AKDT until October 16 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and blowing snow expected. Total snow accumulations up
to one inch. Winds gusting as high as 40 mph.

* WHERE...Central and Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...From 4 PM this afternoon to 4 PM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Areas of blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile at times.
items.areas: Central Beaufort Sea Coast; Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast
items.instruction: Slow down and use caution while traveling.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued October 15 at 3:05AM AKDT until October 17 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow and gusty winds expected. Total snow accumulations of 2
to 5 inches with locally higher amounts above pass level. Winds
gusting up to around 30 to 40 mph.

* WHERE...Dalton, Elliott, and Steese Highway Summits, White
Mountains, and Higher Terrain South of the Yukon River.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 10 AM AKDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Gusty winds could lead to
areas of blowing snow which could reduce visibility below one half
mile at times.

* ADDI
items.areas: Dalton Highway Summits; White Mountains and High Terrain South of the Yukon River
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 15 at 12:57AM AKDT until October 15 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 55 mph
expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka, Prince of Wales Island, and
Western Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...Until 4 PM AKDT this afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest wind gusts are expected Thursday night
into Friday. Gusts above 1000 ft may exceed 60 mph.
items.areas: City and Borough of Sitka; Western Kupreanof and Kuiu Island; Prince of Wales Island
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.
